name: Helium recovery
principle: Helium is a trace component of some natural gases. It concentrates in the nitrogen-rich off-gas of the liquefaction or nitrogen-rejection unit, is upgraded to crude helium, purified, liquefied and shipped. Qatar's Helium 2 plant takes crude helium from six LNG trains.

process_steps.name: Helium-rich flash gas from LNG trains or NRU

suppliers.name: Linde Engineering
suppliers.product: PSA plus HISELECT helium purification hybrid with NRU

performance.basis: RasGas Helium 2, operational July 2013; with the existing plant 2 billion cubic feet per year

source.note: Gulf Times, New plant takes Qatar to top spot in helium export, 9 July 2013
